biggest_catch: This is a business-only product — an individual consumer cannot get it — and earning the bonus requires putting $4,000 of real business spend on the Brex Card within 30 days of activation.
catches: BUSINESS ONLY: the official terms define 'You' and 'your' as 'the business participating in or seeking to participate in this Offer' — individual consumers are not eligible.
The route's $200 claim is stale/wrong: the current official September 2026 activation offer pays a $1,000 USD statement credit, not $200.
You must apply between September 1 and September 30, 2026, be approved, activate with your first purchase, then spend at least $4,000 in Qualifying Spend within the first 30 days after activation.

Qualifying Spend excludes cash withdrawals, commercial utilities, money transfers, prepaid cards and cash equivalents, fees and fines, fraudulent/disputed/chargeback transactions — and Brex may exclude transaction types at any time.
The bonus is only awarded upon payment in full of amounts owed; the account must remain in good standing through the earning and award periods.
Brex reserves the right to cancel or modify the terms or terminate eligibility at any time without prior notice, and may withhold, claw back, or reverse the bonus.
Tax consequences are yours: Brex may request a W-9 and issue tax forms.
Offer cannot be combined with any other promotional bonus offer; qualifying for a Brex account is not guaranteed.

steps: Confirm you are applying as a business — the offer defines 'you' as the business; individual consumers are not eligible.
Between September 1 and September 30, 2026, apply for a new Brex account and Brex Card and get approved (approval is not guaranteed).
Activate the account with your first purchase on the Brex Card — activation starts the 30-day Earning Period.

Spend at least $4,000 in Qualifying Spend on the Brex Card within those 30 days (net cleared USD; excludes cash withdrawals, utilities, money transfers, prepaid cards, fees/fines, disputed transactions).
Pay the statement balance in full — the bonus is only awarded upon payment in full of amounts owed — and keep the account in good standing.
The $1,000 statement credit is typically applied by your February 2027 statement; expect tax documentation (e.g., W-9/1099) requirements.
